faq.question: How to convert JSON to CSV for Excel?
faq.answer: Paste your JSON array, click Convert to CSV, and download the file. The converter automatically adds UTF-8 BOM for proper Excel compatibility. You can also select GBK encoding for Chinese characters.

faq.question: Does it support nested JSON objects?
faq.answer: Yes! Enable the 'Flatten nested objects' option to automatically flatten nested objects into CSV columns. For example, {"user": {"name": "Alice"}} becomes a column named 'user.name'.

faq.question: Can I select which fields to export?
faq.answer: Yes. After pasting your JSON, click 'Select Fields' to choose which columns to include in the CSV. This is useful when you only need specific data.

faq.question: How to preview the CSV before downloading?
faq.answer: After converting, the table preview automatically appears. You can also toggle it using the 'Show Table Preview' button. This helps verify the conversion looks correct.

faq.question: Is there a limit on the number of records?
faq.answer: There is no artificial limit. Since all processing happens in your browser, the limit depends on your device's memory. You can typically convert thousands of records without issues.

faq.question: How are JSON arrays with different keys handled?
faq.answer: The converter collects all unique keys from all objects in the array and uses them as CSV column headers. If an object is missing a key, that cell will be empty in the CSV output.

faq.question: Is my data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All conversion happens in your browser. Your JSON data never leaves your device. No data is stored or transmitted.

faq.question: What is the difference between UTF-8 and GBK encoding?
faq.answer: UTF-8 is the standard encoding for web and modern applications. GBK is used for older Excel versions and Chinese locale systems. Choose GBK if your CSV shows garbled Chinese characters in Excel.

article.title: How to Convert JSON to CSV for Excel & Google Sheets
article.content:
Why Convert JSON to CSV?

JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is widely used for data exchange between servers and applications. However, when you need to analyze this data, create reports, or share it with non-technical team members, CSV (Comma-Separated Values) is the preferred format. CSV files can be opened directly in Excel, Google Sheets, and any spreadsheet application.

Common Use Cases

  • API Data Export: Convert API responses (JSON) to CSV for analysis in Excel
  • Database Backups: Export database records stored as JSON to spreadsheet format
  • Data Migration: Move data between systems that use different formats
  • Reporting: Create charts and pivot tables from JSON data in Excel

Handling Nested JSON Objects

Real-world JSON data is often nested. For example:

{"user": {"name": "Alice", "address": {"city": "NYC"}}, "status": "active"}

Our converter automatically flattens this into CSV columns:

  • user.name → Alice
  • user.address.city → NYC
  • status → active

Excel Compatibility Tips

  1. Use UTF-8 BOM: Our converter adds a Byte Order Mark (BOM) to ensure Excel correctly reads UTF-8 characters
  2. GBK Encoding: For older Excel versions or Chinese locale, select GBK encoding
  3. Field Selection: Only export the fields you need to keep your spreadsheet clean

Best Practices

  • Preview First: Always check the table preview before downloading
  • Validate Data: Ensure your JSON array contains objects with consistent structure
  • Large Files: For very large JSON files (100MB+), consider splitting into chunks

article.title: 如何将 JSON 转换为 Excel 和 Google Sheets 可用的 CSV
article.content:
为什么要将 JSON 转换为 CSV？

JSON（JavaScript Object Notation）广泛用于服务器和应用程序之间的数据交换。然而，当你需要分析这些数据、创建报表或与非技术人员共享时，CSV（逗号分隔值）是首选格式。CSV 文件可以直接在 Excel、Google Sheets 和任何电子表格应用程序中打开。

常见使用场景

  • API 数据导出：将 API 响应（JSON）转换为 CSV 以便在 Excel 中分析
  • 数据库备份：将以 JSON 格式存储的数据库记录导出为电子表格格式
  • 数据迁移：在使用不同格式的系统之间迁移数据
  • 报表生成：在 Excel 中基于 JSON 数据创建图表和数据透视表

处理嵌套 JSON 对象

现实世界中的 JSON 数据通常是嵌套的。例如：

{"user": {"name": "Alice", "address": {"city": "NYC"}}, "status": "active"}

我们的转换器会自动将其展平为 CSV 列：

  • user.name → Alice
  • user.address.city → NYC
  • status → active

Excel 兼容性技巧

  1. 使用 UTF-8 BOM：我们的转换器添加字节顺序标记（BOM），确保 Excel 正确读取 UTF-8 字符
  2. GBK 编码：对于旧版 Excel 或中文 locale，选择 GBK 编码
  3. 字段选择：只导出需要的字段，保持电子表格整洁

最佳实践

  • 先预览：下载前务必检查表格预览
  • 验证数据：确保 JSON 数组包含结构一致的对象
  • 大文件处理：对于非常大的 JSON 文件（100MB+），考虑分块处理
